types.name: Malware and virus types
types.description: Describes a harmful program (spreads by itself, hides as a useful app, locks files for money, records keys) and asks which malware or virus type it is.

types.name: Phishing and social engineering
types.description: Describes tricking a person by email, phone, SMS or a fake website into giving away passwords or money, and asks for the name of the trick.

types.name: Hacking and network attacks
types.description: Describes a technical attack such as flooding a server, listening in between two parties, guessing passwords or injecting code, and asks for its name.

types.name: Firewalls, antivirus and safe practices
types.description: Asks what a firewall, antivirus, VPN, two-factor login, CAPTCHA, patch or backup does, or which practice keeps a system safe.

types.name: Encryption, keys and digital signatures
types.description: Asks about plaintext and ciphertext, symmetric and public-key encryption, which key signs or encrypts, hashing, certificates or HTTPS.

types.name: Cyber law, agencies and hacker types
types.description: Asks about the IT Act 2000 and its sections, CERT-In, the cybercrime helpline, or white, black and grey hat hackers.
